conditions: Local gfx1151. Runs executed sequentially, with no concurrent hrxdb GPU tests or benchmarks. Other system activity and clocks were not controlled. Three warmups and ten measured queries per run.
retention: All timing samples, result counts, aggregate statistics, and compiler reports are retained. Per-query neighbor arrays are omitted for compactness; each run passed the benchmark full-score CPU selection and returned-score validation.

runs.timing: Host wall time with explicit completion; three warmups; serialized changing queries; scan/control exclude query preparation; search includes normalization, query publication, selection and readback. GB/s uses unpadded FP16 vector bytes and decimal GB.
runs.validation: GPU selection checked against a CPU top-k over the entire GPU score array for each configuration. Sampled scores include the allocation tail and 4 GiB boundary; all returned scores checked against quantized CPU reference. This is not an exhaustive CPU recomputation of every dot product.
